runner_control.changes: CPU identity display supports Linux; round-trip/context checks are unchanged.

hypothesis: Reconstruct the missing BITLSTM trace writer while preserving the original compressor and every live integer prediction. Establish replayable data before any training experiment.
rule: Change only src/bit_head.cpp in disposable builds. Copy live raw stage-1 columns 0..6 and 21..26, mixer output, base probability and actual bit. Copy already computed 32+32 state projections and four TF scalars/zone every eight model bits. Save the corrected integer probability separately. No model, retrieval, phase, seed, weight or FP-flag change.
acceptance: Exact prepared and original XML restoration
Archive bytes and SHA-256 identical to the saved uninstrumented baseline
Context counts unchanged; trace, channel and integer-probability hashes equal for encoder and decoder
Validate upstream headers, exact record lengths, finite features, valid flags/probabilities, and ceil(model_bits/8) channel records
Trace is bounded to 16000000 model bits, safely below the runtime online-learning threshold; overflow fails rather than silently truncating
Preserve failures; do not train until a separate replay check reproduces every live integer probability
limitations: These reused fixtures are research data, not untouched validation.
Fixture traces include exactly the Adjust/Observe calls the development runner makes, including any pretraining calls; these are not advertised as the original full training trace.
The source package omits the original writer. Matching its documented format does not reconstruct its historical data.
Trace sizes and concurrent timings are developer costs, not a final submission score or runtime claim.
scope: Read-only fixture trace reconstruction. Raw traces stay local; commit hashes, counts, logs and source provenance. No new model weights or training.
followup: Verify frozen shipped BF16 weights under the public replay trainer against every recorded corrected probability, with matching reset rhythm and no optimizer updates, before designing a separate training protocol.
reader_correction: Before completion, a source audit found gate zones 0..5 in tf1_gate.h. The first reader wrongly allowed only 0..3. Accept all six declared zones; emitted C++ and recording format are unchanged. Historical recipe revision and exact generated source remain verified.
